why: The expansion followed `npm run x` into the BODY of the script and stopped at `node <file>`. Measured on 2026-08-30: `ducado` was accused of "the CI does not reach: lint" with `.github/workflows/verificar.yml` running `npm run verificar`, the `verificar` script being `node ci/verificar.mjs`, and that file running `npm run --silent lint` on line 21. The real chain has three links and the expansion walked two — stopping at the `node` was declaring that the CI does not reach the lint it reaches on every run. Both sides have the SAME workflow, the SAME package.json and the SAME runner: only the list of steps INSIDE the runner changes.
